shared_elements: repeated linear motifs arranged in registers or zones
justification: A depicts a narrative figural scene — armed human figures, horses, a wheeled chariot, archers — carved in low relief with naturalistic proportions and profile poses, while B carries only abstract geometric ornament of hatched zigzags, chevrons and triangles filled with parallel incised lines. The only correspondence is the generic fact that both surfaces bear incised decoration organised into roughly horizontal zones; there is no shared motif, figure or relationship whatsoever.
